output_list.criticism: The transferFrom function in the StandardToken contract does not have proper checks to prevent integer overflow. This vulnerability allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, potentially leading to loss of funds or other unintended consequences.

The unfreeze function in the SPXToken contract allows the ICO smart contract owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, aka the 'freezeOut' issue. This vulnerability can be exploited to manipulate token balances and potentially gain unauthorized access to the token contract.
